input.goal: Grow non-brand organic traffic to product and collection pages

findings.issue: Collection pages may not clearly target how shoppers search by trip length and pack capacity.
findings.fix: Map one primary intent such as day hiking backpacks or multi-day hiking backpacks to each collection, then align its title, heading, introduction, and product links to that intent.

findings.issue: Product descriptions may leave comparison questions unanswered.
findings.fix: Add scannable details for capacity, fit, weight, use case, and warranty, and link each product back to its closest collection and buying guide.

quick_wins: Give every collection a unique search-focused title and visible introductory paragraph.
Add descriptive internal links from buying guides to the matching products and collections.
output.summary: Start by making collection intent explicit, then strengthen product comparison copy and internal links.

input.niche: Local family and cosmetic dentistry in Bishkek
input.goal: Increase qualified appointment requests from local search

findings.issue: Core services may not each have a dedicated page aligned to local patient intent.
findings.fix: Create distinct, useful pages for priority services such as family dentistry, emergency appointments, and whitening, including location, process, eligibility, and booking details.

findings.issue: Business identity and location signals should be checked for consistency.
findings.fix: Verify the same clinic name, address, phone, hours, and appointment URL across the website and major local profiles.

quick_wins: Put the clinic location and appointment action in the title, main heading, and visible page copy where natural.
Add a short FAQ answering cost, availability, and first-visit questions on each priority service page.
output.summary: Build clear service pages and consistent local business signals before expanding informational content.

input.niche: Accounts receivable automation software for small B2B teams

findings.issue: The site may not separate category, use-case, and comparison search intent.
findings.fix: Assign distinct pages to accounts receivable automation, invoice follow-up workflows, and relevant alternative or comparison queries, with unique proof and calls to action.

findings.issue: Educational content may attract traffic without leading readers toward the product.
findings.fix: Create topic clusters around late-payment prevention and collections workflows, then link each guide to the most relevant feature or use-case page.

quick_wins: Rewrite the homepage title and main heading to state the product category and target customer plainly.
Add contextual links from existing receivables articles to one matching use-case page.
output.summary: Clarify the SaaS category first, then connect educational demand to focused use-case and comparison pages.

negative_cases.reason: priority must be high, medium, or low
